note: STEP 2 of the composite pass - items that cannot be done until the logo / palette / silhouette assets are final. Sheet = 1448x1086. Boxes are x0,y0,x1,y1 measured on the frozen v1.1 composites (+-2 px). Apply on top of the STEP 1 outputs in this folder, write each composite once.

inputs_required.logo: m4-release/logo/ (ONE clean transparent LOGO_ASSET master, PNG or SVG-rendered PNG; same wording/mark as the approved logo)
inputs_required.palette: final six-slot palette per character (hex + names; Bronco CHARACTER-SPECIFIC = BANDANA - MAROON, ACCENT = red star/gear)
inputs_required.silhouettes: m4-release/library/<char>/<char>_silhouette_front.png derived from approved matted alpha (flat navy)

logo.rule: Replace the baked raster logo; the paw-in-Zoo mark, 'BidaZoo' wordmark, 'WORLD EXPEDITION' board and compass are all inside the asset. Scale the asset so its board bbox matches the sign bbox below; paste with alpha; then check that no old-logo pixel remains visible outside the new alpha (leftover foliage/board fringe): measure inside the foliage bbox, require < 0.5 % mismatch, else add a 2-3 px cv2.inpaint ring around the new alpha. Do not add any separate 'BidaZoo World Expedition' header text (doc 16 s13).

00.z_order: the 'Visual Production Guide' parchment banner (arc, y 214-262) sits IN FRONT of the logo bottom edge: paste the logo first, then restore banner pixels from the STEP 1 image inside the banner polygon; Click's ear tip stays behind the banner (STEP 1 already did this)

silhouettes.rule: Replace the six baked silhouettes (old flat-sheet art, Eagle still the brown-crested one) by flat-navy silhouettes from the approved front alpha, drawn at the same cast-relative scale as 07 panel 1 (height = H_eagle * k, ref_height from the manifest), common baseline, centered on the existing label centers. Then retype the 6 labels in Nunito Sans (00: navy-tinted per-character color text -> Nunito Sans Bold 700, 11 px; 07: white ExtraBold 800 on the existing colored pills, 10 px caps). Silhouettes are NOT a height authority (doc 15 s6).

palette_07.panel_chip_row: retitle subtitle (217,468,690,490): replace 'Core colors for each character. Use these swatches to maintain consistency across all media.' by 'Core colors for each character. PROVISIONAL - values are not final palette authority.' (Nunito Sans SemiBold 600, 11 px) unless the lead marks the palette final, in which case drop the PROVISIONAL clause
palette_07.text: per row: role label (Nunito Sans SemiBold 600, 10.5 px, sentence case) at swatch_cx+16, hex (Nunito Sans Regular 400, 10 px, caps #RRGGBB, tabular) at swatch_cx+57; erase the baked label+hex with the same row-median erase used in compfx.retype; refill swatch squares with the final hex (flat, 1 px darker border)
palette_07.five_row_card_limit: The cards have 5 rows and doc 15 wants six slots, but the row compression was reverted by the owner: do NOT shrink rows. Keep five rows; for Bronco put the bandana in row 4

bronco_card.row_4: REPLACE old 'Gear #B91C1C' (the old crimson bandana definition) by 'Bandana (Maroon)' with the final maroon hex (provisional values: doc 09 #8E1B30, sheet swatch #9F0A26)

palette_07.other_cards: re-print hex strings from the final palette JSON so printed text == swatch pixels (doc 09 s6: Eagle Secondary/Detail printed text was off 64/108 RGB units); optional 'PROVISIONAL' tag right-aligned in the panel chip row

text_not_in_step_1_or_2: all other baked AI raster text on 00/07/08 (chips, taglines, sign tabs, nameplates, environment labels, HUD numerals, design-rule paragraphs, hex are covered above) is OPTIONAL: see the audit report; boxes in the report.
status: APPLIED by step2.py (called from build_composites.py). Kept as the measured-box record; see step2.py for the final constants.
